newsitem.title: USA: Essef Corp declares 10 pct stock dividend.
newsitem.headline: Essef Corp declares 10 pct stock dividend.

text.p: Essef Corp said Thursday its board of directors had declared a 10 percent stock dividend payable on Feb 28 to shareholders of record on Feb 7, 1997.

"The board has long recognized the limited availability of our stock and the difficulty that many potential investors have in purchasing shares of Essef common stock," company chief executive officer Thomas Waldin said in a prepared statement.
He said the board would evaluate future stock dividends on an annual basis.

The company designs and manufactures components to move, store and treat water through the application of high-performance polymeric materials and is a major supplier of swimming pool water treatment equipment.
